targets.title: The dynamics and spillovers of management interventions: Evidence from the training within industry program.
targets.evidence_quote: In this paper, we investigate whether the results presented in BG are repro- ducible and replicable, and further test the sensitivity of the main results to the following changes: (1) use annual sales and ROA in levels rather than their logarith- mic transformations; (2) vary the fixed effects employed in the main specification; (3) employ modern difference-in-difference estimators that are robust to heterogene- ity in treatment effects in the presence of staggered adoption of treatment.
targets.outcome_computational_quote: We were ultimately able to reproduce the results reported in the main body of the paper.
targets.outcome_robustness_quote: Our sensitivity analyses show that, overall, the results are robust to changes to the main specification.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Main-body central findings reproduced after software corrections and author correspondence. Residual appendix discrepancies are reported as not changing substantive conclusions. Reasonable alternative specifications preserve the main findings; the smaller survival effect is supplementary and remains economically significant.

reasoning: Uses original data and code to reproduce and test robustness of a single published paper. References to estimators and earlier reproduction are not additional targets. Identity and article boundaries verified against title, authors, cover, abstract and reference list.
